close_reason: Created jmap-jscontact-types crate with 24 RFC 9553 typed sub-types (Name family, Org family, Contact family, Calendaring family, Address family, Resource family x5, Anniversary family, Note family, PersonalInfo, Relation) plus AnniversaryDate sum-type and JsContactId newtype. 31 round-trip tests against RFC 9553 worked examples (Figures 13, 16, 19, 21-32, 34, 36-38, 41, 43, 44). cargo test --workspace clean, cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings clean, RUSTDOCFLAGS=-D warnings cargo doc --no-deps clean. PLAN.md documents why Localization and Keyword are not included (not RFC object types). Committed as a234050.
description:
Create directory crate-jmap-jscontact-types/ with the standard foundation-shaped type-crate scaffolding (Cargo.toml, lib.rs with #![forbid(unsafe_code)], AGENTS.md, PLAN.md, README.md). Mirror jmap-jscalendar-types' layout (see JMAP-x59i.1).

Define 22 typed sub-types covering the ContactCard sloppy fields:
- Name, Nickname, Organization, Title, SpeakToAs
- EmailAddress, OnlineService, Phone, LanguagePref, Address
- CryptoKey, Directory, Link, Media
- Anniversary, PersonalInfo, Localization, RelatedTo
- Calendar, SchedulingAddress, Note, Keyword

Each type:
- Serialize + Deserialize + Debug + Clone + PartialEq
- #[non_exhaustive]
- Doc-comment citing the relevant RFC 9553 section
- #[serde(rename_all = 'camelCase')]

Round-trip tests for each type using hand-written RFC 9553 example JSON fixtures (oracle-independent — DO NOT derive expected values from code under test).

Add to workspace Cargo.toml as a workspace member.

Deps: serde, serde_json only. No async. No JMAP dep. Cookie-cutter shape: foundation type-crate (model on jmap-types / jmap-jscalendar-types).
title: Create new jmap-jscontact-types crate (scaffolding + 22 RFC 9553 typed sub-types)
